Back up and restore MySQL servers

goback works with MySQL 5.5 through 8.4. Dumps and the binary log go into separate sets.

```sh
goback [global flags] mysql <command>
```

## mysql receive

Receive the server's binlogs as a replica and commit them to the set named by --set until SIGTERM

receive reads host, port, socket, user, password and ssl-mode from the [client] group of
--defaults-extra-file and ~/.my.cnf. The user needs REPLICATION SLAVE and REPLICATION CLIENT. receive
starts at the newest dump's binlog, so take a dump first. After RESET MASTER, the binlogs continue in
a new chain in the same set.

```sh
goback [global flags] mysql receive [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--spool value` | directory that holds binlogs until they are committed | `GOBACK_MYSQL_SPOOL` |  |
| `--dump-set value` | set that holds the server's dumps |  |  |
| `--defaults-extra-file value` | MySQL option file with the connection settings and password; read before ~/.my.cnf | `GOBACK_MYSQL_DEFAULTS_EXTRA_FILE` |  |
| `--server-id value` | server id to connect with as a replica; derived from the set's name by default |  |  |
| `--commit-every value` | how often to commit new binlog; at least 10s |  | `1m0s` |
| `--commit-bytes value` | commit early once this much new binlog has arrived |  | `256MiB` |
| `--window value` | how far back point-in-time recovery reaches; binlogs older than the oldest dump in this window are retired |  | `336h0m0s` |
| `--shutdown-grace value` | how long the last commit may take after SIGTERM |  | `30s` |

## mysql dump

Dump the server with mysqldump and commit it to the set named by --set

The MySQL client programs read their connection settings from ~/.my.cnf or --defaults-extra-file.
With log_bin on, the dump records the binary log position it is consistent with.

```sh
goback [global flags] mysql dump [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--binlog-set value` | set that holds the server's binlogs; the dump joins its chain |  |  |
| `--no-binlog-position` | skip recording the binary log position, even with log_bin on; the dump then needs no global read lock and no RELOAD or REPLICATION CLIENT privilege |  |  |
| `--defaults-extra-file value` | MySQL option file with the connection settings and password; the client programs read it before their own option files; without it, they read only ~/.my.cnf | `GOBACK_MYSQL_DEFAULTS_EXTRA_FILE` |  |
| `--mysql value` | the mysql client to run | `GOBACK_MYSQL` | `mysql` |
| `--mysqldump value` | the mysqldump program to run | `GOBACK_MYSQLDUMP` | `mysqldump` |
| `--mysqlbinlog value` | the mysqlbinlog program that restore replays binlogs with; its version must be at least the source server's | `GOBACK_MYSQLBINLOG` | `mysqlbinlog` |

## mysql restore

Load a dump into an empty running server, then replay the binlog set if one is given

The MySQL client programs read the target's connection settings from ~/.my.cnf or
--defaults-extra-file. With --to, restore writes the dump and the binlogs into a directory instead
of applying them. It then prints the commands that apply them.

```sh
goback [global flags] mysql restore [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dump-set value` | set that holds the server's dumps |  |  |
| `--binlog-set value` | set that holds the server's binlogs, for restoring past the dump |  |  |
| `--at value` | moment to restore to, in RFC 3339 (2026-10-02T14:30:00Z) to the second; the end of the binlog set by default |  |  |
| `--to value` | empty directory to write the dump and the binlogs into instead of applying them |  |  |
| `--work-dir value` | directory to download the binlogs into before the replay; the system's temporary directory by default |  |  |
| `--force` | load into a server that already holds databases |  |  |
| `--defaults-extra-file value` | MySQL option file with the connection settings and password; the client programs read it before their own option files; without it, they read only ~/.my.cnf | `GOBACK_MYSQL_DEFAULTS_EXTRA_FILE` |  |
| `--mysql value` | the mysql client to run | `GOBACK_MYSQL` | `mysql` |
| `--mysqldump value` | the mysqldump program to run | `GOBACK_MYSQLDUMP` | `mysqldump` |
| `--mysqlbinlog value` | the mysqlbinlog program that restore replays binlogs with; its version must be at least the source server's | `GOBACK_MYSQLBINLOG` | `mysqlbinlog` |
